name: Aeven Patio Lounge Chair
description: Inject a breath of fresh air into your home with this bohemian style accessory. All made of light and airy wicker, the chair features a teardropshaped frame with a geometric weave design for an increased sense of space. Muted Gray finish perfectly complements its elegant silhouette. The sleek, modern look of metal hairpin legs match this freespirited style perfectly. Plush and soft upholstered seat cushions invite you to lounge in a while, enjoying sunlight and breeze that filter through the wicker frame.

name: Galzed Patio Lounge Chair
description: Extremely charming, comfortable, the teardrop patio chair provides an ideal place for relaxing your mind and body. The chair frame is made of white wicker that exudes a light and airy feel, with metal hairpin legs for a modern flair. The elegant teardropshaped frame paired with soft seat cushion makes it more visually appealing. Lounge in pure luxury and comfort with The Galzed Teardrop Patio Chair.

name: Hikre Patio Lounge Chair & Side Table
finish: Clear Glass, Charcoal Fabric & Black Wicker
description: Elegant, airy wickerweaving work offers a lovely retreat to relax your body and soothe your mind. Black wicker frame with metal base highlights the fabulously airy and sturdy construction. Teardropshaped design combines beautiful floral accents to create a sophisticated look. The additional seat cushion will make you feel so comfortable and relaxed lounging in this chair. Complementing side table makes a great place to rest your drink or book with its glass tabletop and stable drum base. Discover a dreamy oasis to stay with Hikre Patio Lounge Chair & Side Table.

name: Simona Hanging Chair
description: Providing extra seating in your outdoor space, the Simona is a modern take on the classic patio swing chair. Intersecting white and black wicker creates a natural contrast and eyecatching style. Decorative versatility comes in the form of the two fabric for seating, green and white fabric that furthers the transitional styling to complete the look.
features: Construction: Wicker & Aluminum Frame, Foam Filling Cushion
